_comment: Maps the canonical agent model TIERS (from each agent's harness-hints.claude-code.model, or an explicit harness-hints.pi.model) to a concrete pi --model pattern. Empty string => omit `model:` so the subagent inherits pi's default model. "opus" is empty on purpose: the spawnable agents run the session's model, so pi uses your default instead of a pinned, ageing ID. "sonnet" / "haiku" are Anthropic IDs from pi's model registry (@earendil-works/pi-ai models.generated.js) for an explicitly cheaper spawn of mechanical work. Override per-run with env PI_MODEL_OPUS / PI_MODEL_SONNET / PI_MODEL_HAIKU. A non-empty Anthropic ID requires an Anthropic provider configured in pi (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or providers config).
